# v5.24 catalog (card E7; the data is `src/content/catalog.ts`, this is its list)

Tiers: small 60, medium 150, large 400 diamonds. A set piece shows only in its set's shop; a generic look shows in every shop; in its own shop a set piece beats the generic look of the same part. `plaque-master` is earned (18 stars), never sold. W5 names every id; S4 and S5 draw the ids of their sets and the generics (S4: Downtown, Suburbs, Waterfront and the generics; S5: University, Industrial, Uptown).

Parts: `facade` (storefront skin / theme), `awning`, `oven`, `counter`, `sign`, `scooter`, `menu` (menu board), `apron`, `tablecloth`, `tipjar`, `chime` (door chime), `plaque`.

Sets (id, shop): `classic` Downtown · `diner` Suburbs · `dockside` Waterfront · `dorm` University · `brick` Industrial · `marble` Uptown.

## Totals

- Looks for sale: 41 (6 existing + 24 set pieces + 11 generic). With the earned plaque, 42 looks.
- Total price of the looks for sale: 900 + 4,020 + 840 = **5,760 diamonds**.
- Featured: 4 per ISO week over the 41; every look is up within 11 weeks (fewer once the player owns some).
